SIP::call_id
Description
Returns the value of the
Call-ID
header in a SIP request. Only the
first 256 bytes of the
Call-ID
will be returned.
Syntax
SIP
::
call_id
SIP::call_id
Returns the value of the ‘’’Call-ID* header in a SIP request.
Examples
when
SIP_REQUEST_SEND
{
if
{[
SIP
::
method
]
==
"BYE"
}
{
persist
delete
sip
[
SIP
::
call_id
]
}
}
